vectors.name: attestation_without_an_attested_at
vectors.note: an unset Timestamp renders as null; the type generator flattens it to a string schema, so a rule written for message-typed fields refuses it

vectors.name: rate_limit_without_a_reset_time
vectors.note: the same unset Timestamp, on the message every discovery answer that reports a rate limit carries

vectors.name: response_carrying_a_rate_limit_without_a_reset_time
vectors.note: one unset Timestamp one level down refuses the WHOLE answer, which is what a caller actually meets

vectors.name: defaulted_scalar_sent_as_null
vectors.note: a null on a field carrying a default is the default, not an absence — the oracle reads keyid as the empty string
